categories.name: Math & numbers
categories.description: Basic math, fractions, percentages and number theory

tools.title: Scientific Calculator
tools.description: Evaluate scientific expressions, exponents, trigonometry, logarithms and more.
tools.formula: Arithmetic, trig, logs, roots, combinations and constants.

tools.title: Equation Solver
tools.description: Solve linear, quadratic and general single-variable equations numerically and see real roots.
tools.formula: Numerical root finding scans a finite interval; some functions have additional roots or no real roots.

tools.title: Quadratic Equation Solver
tools.description: Solve ax² + bx + c = 0, including complex roots.

tools.title: Simultaneous Equation Solver
tools.description: Solve 2×2 and 3×3 systems of linear equations.

tools.title: Expression Evaluator
tools.description: Evaluate or sample a math expression after substituting variable values.
tools.formula: Numeric evaluation only; not a general symbolic CAS.

tools.title: Function Graphing Calculator
tools.description: Plot functions y=f(x) and compare up to three graphs interactively.
tools.formula: Cartesian function plot; drag, zoom and download PNG.

tools.title: Derivative Calculator
tools.description: Estimate derivatives at a point and draw tangent lines.
tools.formula: f′(x) ≈ (f(x+h) − f(x−h))/(2h). Numerical estimate, not symbolic differentiation.

tools.title: Definite Integral Calculator
tools.description: Numerically evaluate definite integrals using composite Simpson integration.
tools.formula: Composite Simpson’s rule; discontinuities and singularities may invalidate the result.

tools.title: Numerical Limit Calculator
tools.description: Estimate the left- and right-hand limits of a function.
tools.formula: Numerical sampling near a point; not a proof of a limit.

tools.title: Matrix Calculator
tools.description: Add, multiply, transpose, invert and find determinants of matrices.
tools.formula: Gaussian elimination and standard matrix operations.

tools.title: Statistics Calculator
tools.description: Compute mean, median, mode, variance, deviation, quartiles and more.
tools.formula: Sample and population statistics shown separately.

tools.title: Correlation & Regression
tools.description: Calculate Pearson correlation and a least-squares regression line.
tools.formula: Pearson r and least-squares line; association does not establish causation.

tools.title: Binomial Probability
tools.description: Calculate exact binomial probabilities with n trials and success rate p.

tools.title: Universal Unit Converter
tools.description: Convert length, area, volume, mass, speed, time, pressure, energy, power, data, angle and temperature.
tools.formula: Uses common standard conversion factors; some units are context-dependent.

tools.title: Number Base Converter
tools.description: Convert integers between binary, octal, decimal, hexadecimal and bases 2–36.

tools.title: Fraction Calculator
tools.description: Add, subtract, multiply, divide and simplify fractions exactly.
